task.title: Treat CAS origin enrichment as optional metadata
task.problem: Invalid UTF-8 or unavailable .gitreview metadata can abort otherwise valid searches.
task.proposal: Read bytes, decode with replacement and cache enrichment failure as unavailable metadata.
acceptance: Invalid UTF-8 metadata does not affect exit status or file matches.
Unavailable metadata is tested without suppressing actual file traversal failures.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.
